name: In-car apps (CarPlay and Android Auto)
plain: Shows an app on the car dashboard within strict templates.
meaning: Cars are safety critical, so both vendors restrict app categories and UI.

android.permission: androidx.car.app.* permissions per category; no runtime prompt
android.prompt_ui: Android Auto connects; Play review by category
android.store_policy: Play: car app categories and quality review
android.note: Categories include navigation, parking, charging, media, messaging

limits.headline: Can show the app on your car screen, but only in a few fixed layouts
limits.user_action: You plug in or connect your phone to the car and tap the app on the car screen
can: Show a simple screen on the dashboard in an approved layout
Play audio, give directions, or show charging and parking info if it is in an allowed category
Show messages by voice in a limited way
cannot: Use a free design with video, games or long text on the car screen
Appear at all without Apple approval for that category (iPhone) or a Play review (Android)
Take over the car controls such as the steering or speed
limits.differs: Apple gives each category its own entitlement. Android Auto uses a Play review by category.

story.what_it_is: Lets approved apps show a simple screen on your car dashboard.

marketing.name: CarPlay
marketing.pitch: Use your iPhone in the car with a simpler, safer view on the car display.

marketing.name: Android Auto
marketing.pitch: Bring your favorite apps to the car screen with big buttons and voice control.

story.for_you: Your phone apps show up on the car screen with big buttons and voice control. You can get directions, play music and answer messages without touching the phone.
story.for_makers: Cars are safety critical, so Apple and Google only allow certain app types (navigation, music, messaging, charging, parking) and fixed screen templates. Makers use it to stay in the driver's day and reach people who never open the phone while driving.

use_cases.example: Your navigation app draws turn by turn directions on the dashboard and reroutes around a crash in real time.
Your playlist and podcasts appear as a simple list; you tell the voice assistant 'play my road trip mix'.
Incoming texts are read out loud and you reply by voice, so the phone stays in the cup holder.
An electric car owner sees nearby chargers with free plugs and starts a charge from the dashboard.
A food delivery driver gets the next pickup address on the car screen while keeping eyes on the road.
Games stay off the dashboard on purpose. Car makers allow trivia style voice audio games only in some cars while parked.

risks: Location and trip history shared with the car
story.android_note: Android Auto runs from the phone and also has a version built into some cars (Android Automotive).
story.ios_note: CarPlay is limited to Apple approved app categories, and apps need a special entitlement from Apple.

technical_bounds: Apps cannot draw arbitrary UI; templates only

history.change: CarPlay widgets, Live Activities and Ultra
